name: GNOME Speaks
description: Voice for your desktop — dictation, AI conversation, spellbook commands, and a wake word. Speech runs on Azure or on your own local Wyoming server (Piper / Parakeet), whichever you make primary, with the other as fallback. Requires the companion gnome-speaks service (audio/STT/TTS run outside the shell): setup at https://github.com/techempower-org/gnome-speaks
